claims: The solution builds with zero warnings and zero errors under the repository analyzers.
Every catalog page constructs and the shell constructs.
A reported failure returns a well-formed 12-hex reference, is stored, and is redacted.
The toast is produced by the pipeline, carries the reference, and carries no secret.
One audit row is written per write and per refusal.
The failure store and log resolve under the per-user data root and never beside the executable.
limits: No live database, provider, API or identity server.
The window was constructed but not shown; no screenshot, pixel, accessibility or RTL verification.
The business audit store is a local SQLite table, not yet Beep.OilandGas.Repository.
The source guards are heuristics: they read source text and prove reporting presence, not correctness of the report.
